name: Hans Makart
tagline: Austrian academic history painter, designer, and decorator (1840–1884)
bio: Hans Makart was an Austrian academic history painter, designer and decorator. Makart was a prolific painter whose ideas significantly influenced the development of visual art in Austria-Hungary, Germany, and other countries.
